'''Fabio Garbari''' (born 1937) is an Italian botanist who has a degree in Biological Science from the University of Pisa awarded in 1958. From 1963 to 2007 he was a faculty member in the Department of Botanical Science (''{{lang|it|Dipartimento di Scienze Botaniche}}'') of the [[University of Pisa]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.bionat.unipi.it/sn/SN_docenti_new.html |title=Scienze Biologiche – Docenti |access-date=2011-11-21 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120425234920/http://www.bionat.unipi.it/sn/SN_docenti_new.html |archive-date=2012-04-25 |url-status=dead }}</ref> In 2019 he was awarded the [[Veitch Memorial Medal]] by the [[Royal Horticultural Society]].<ref name="Cosgrove2019">{{cite news |last1=Cosgrove |first1=Sarah |title=Tony Kirkham, Fergus Garrett and Bill Simpson become RHS Victoria Medal of Honour holders |url=https://www.hortweek.com/tony-kirkham-fergus-garrett-bill-simpson-become-rhs-victoria-medal-honour-holders/horticulture-careers/article/1581410 |access-date=1 October 2021 |work=Horticulture Week |issue=8 April 2019}}</ref> The [[International Plant Names Index]] lists 37 taxa named by Garbari.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Garbari, Fabio {{!}} International Plant Names Index |url=https://www.ipni.org/a/3014-1 |access-date=2025-01-12 |website=International Plant Names Index}}</ref>
